categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically orders and revocations of orders under Section 4(1) regarding arbitration of industrial disputes. It involves statutory instruments, legal procedures for dispute resolution, and regulatory actions under existing legislation, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories.
